### Cause of Failure
The downstream service `analytics-ingest` enforces architectural consumer contract **ARCH-4**, which requires `OrderPlaced.channel` to be present as an enum (`"web" | "store" | "marketplace"`). Removing `channel` from the event schema breaks this consumer contract in CI.

### Resolution
Restored `channel` across the domain model, event schema, and API parsing:
- **`OrderPlaced` event** ([`src/core/events.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/events.ts)): Restored `channel: Channel` on [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L25) and populated it in [`orderPlaced()`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/events.ts#L42-L59).
- **Order domain model** ([`src/core/order.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/order.ts)): Restored `CHANNELS`, `Channel` type, and `channel` on [`Order`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/order.ts#L16-L29), [`NewOrder`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/order.ts#L31-L38), and [`createOrder()`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/order.ts#L59-L79).
- **Request parsing** ([`src/api/requestParsing.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/api/requestParsing.ts)): Restored `channel` parsing in [`parsePlaceOrderRequest`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/api/requestParsing.ts#L11-L41).
- **Tests & Documentation**: Re-enabled `channel` in unit tests and documentation examples.

- `npm run typecheck` passed with 0 errors.
- `npm test` passed all 39 tests.
- `npm run arch` passed with 0 violations.
